rationale: Stiven's work on AI and computer vision for surgical navigation at Braillic could benefit from Jiale's deep expertise in ML infrastructure and distributed training systems—particularly as Braillic scales its ArNav platform and seeks to hire additional engineers. While Jiale is based in infrastructure and systems work rather than medical applications, his experience building scalable ML platforms at Meta and Uber aligns with the technical challenges Braillic will face growing its AI-driven surgical guidance software.
intro_message: Stiven Ding, meet Jiale Zhi — Jiale's background scaling ML infrastructure at Meta and Uber could offer useful perspectives as Braillic grows its computer vision and AI capabilities for surgical navigation.
